verdict.line: You lose if he walls you into an extended Last Rites/Mourning Mist trade, you win if you force skirmishes while his W (Dark Procession) is down or once your R (Demacian Justice) comes online at 6.

brief.thesis: Yorick's entire plan is to use W (Dark Procession) to wall you into a corner and grind you down with Q (Last Rites) healing and E (Mourning Mist) slows/marks — that's why he holds the solo-kill edge even though the lane is measured even at 49% over 1139 games. Garen has no dash to escape a cage, so the matchup is decided by whether you fight on his wall-up cooldown or yours. Once R (Demacian Justice) unlocks at 6, the threat of an execute flips who's afraid to stand and trade.

theirWindow.when: W (Dark Procession) is up near terrain
theirWindow.what: He will wall you in against a lane edge or jungle wall, then chain Q (Last Rites) heal and E (Mourning Mist) slow/mark to grind you down over several seconds. Do not stand and trade here — back off the wall line immediately or use Q (Decisive Strike) to break the E slow and get out.

yourWindow.when: his W (Dark Procession) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no cage available (20/18/16/14/12s cooldown), he has no way to trap you in an extended fight. Walk up and trade E (Judgment) into him freely, since he has to out-damage you in the open instead.

start.why: The 54.8%-picked start (50% WR over 776 games) stacks with Perseverance's passive regen so you can shrug off his poke and still have health left when he tries to cage you with W.

boots.why: The 68.8%-picked boots (51.4% WR over 947 games) give the attack speed to make E (Judgment) and auto trades hurt more during the windows his wall is down.

core.why: Gives you the burst and slow to punish him before he can land a second W cage or disengage through his own wall.
The 24.9%-picked path (55.2% WR over 239 games) adds attack speed to stack more E (Judgment) ticks and auto resets in a caged fight.
Grievous Wounds directly answers OP.GG's own call to buy anti-heal — it cuts his Q (Last Rites) self-heal and grave sustain hard.

situational.when: you need anti-heal online before Mortal Reminder finishes to blunt his Last Rites sustain
you're losing races to his Mourning Mist slow and need the move speed stacks to close distance
you want extra mobility to dive him or escape before his W wall seals shut

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking sustain and bonus healing rewards exactly the extended, caged skirmishes Yorick's W forces — the longer the fight drags inside his wall, the more Conqueror pays you back.

summoners.why: The 94%-picked combo (49.8% WR) — Ignite cuts into Last Rites healing the moment you commit, and secures the execute window once R (Demacian Justice) is live at 6.

playing.title: Track his W cooldown constantly
playing.detail: Dark Procession is his only way to trap you (20/18/16/14/12s). If it's down, he cannot cage you — trade freely.

playing.title: Save Q to break his slow
playing.detail: Decisive Strike clears all slows on you, so hold it to escape a Mourning Mist slow or an early wall attempt rather than using it as a damage poke.

playing.title: Spin on cooldown, not on cue
playing.detail: Judgment's cooldown drops to 9s at rank 5 — refreshing it on cooldown out-paces his wall timer and keeps pressure on even outside a cage.

playing.title: Rush anti-heal pieces
playing.detail: Executioner's Calling into Mortal Reminder directly shuts down the Last Rites heal and grave sustain that let him win extended fights.

playing.title: All-in the moment R is up
playing.detail: OP.GG's own measured tip is to try to kill him after level 6 — Demacian Justice flips skirmishes from even into lethal for you.

playing.title: Never fight blind near walls
playing.detail: His Mist Walkers swarm from his passive the instant a fight starts near terrain he can wall off, adding free chip damage while you're caged.

playing.title: Disengage before the cage closes
playing.detail: If he starts channeling W near a choke point, leave immediately — once the wall finishes, Q's slow-break is your only way out.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, boots, runes and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being caged inside Yorick’s (E). Purchase items that reduce healing and use your abilities whenever they come off cooldown to deal damage before retreating. Try to kill him after reaching level 6.
